issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Build a small benchmark from the word-count source and measure its system under test on it.

- The benchmark: for each line of `sentences.txt`, the number of words on it, by the rule in the source's README. Derive the ground truth from the pinned file with a reproducible step and check it against the reference answer set the world has; record any difference.
- Publish a task package without the answers: the text the system reads and how its output is read.
- Run the system under test, `system/count_words.py`, unchanged, on the published task package and keep the run's record.
- Score the run: exact match per line, and the accuracy over the eight lines.
- Audit: reproduce the ground truth and the score from the records, list and explain every line the system got wrong, and approve the release when it holds.

Keep it small: this is the whole benchmark; no other sources and no paid services.
issue.title: Benchmark objective
